sara.partnerops: Kickoff for SI Skill Sprint — Wed May 18 10:00am PT. Objective: 2-day hands-on labs + timed certification. We need trainer leads, hardware voucher plan, and cloud marketplace sandbox checks. Who can take which piece? :rocket:
martin.engineering: I can run the runtime deep-dive lab (serving/runtime/observability). Will need a reproducible env and sample prompts. Also need marketplace sandbox creds.
alyssa.devex: I'll own the cert rubric and proctoring workflow. Can we reuse the new exam flow (internal link) and add a practical task? https://docs.redwood.example/si-cert-flow :memo:
jordan.hw: Hardware partner confirmed 10 dev units available for in-person cohorts, ETA shipping 2026-05-10. I'll handle packing labels but need recipient addresses and customs docs.
sara.partnerops: Great. @jordan.hw please DM logistics list. @martin.engineering do you need specific GPU types? We can request A30/A10.
martin.engineering: Prefer A10s. Estimate 4 A10s per cohort environment. Also would like a small script to repro our load profile for the lab (short tokens, multi-turn).
alyssa.devex: For cert exam timing: propose 90 minutes (30 practical, 60 written). We'll require passing both parts. Anyone object? :thinking_face:
sara.partnerops: No objections. Also note: we need a marketplace listing checklist to ensure the SI can self-deploy with our Dedicated templates. Draft checklist below, feel free to edit.
```
- Confirm model variant pinned in deployment manifest
- Provide sample request/response contract (openapi snippet)
- Include autoscaling policy and quota guidance
- KV cache/latency expectations and observability hooks
- Security: KMS key id, audit log retention
- Contact for emergency rollback (24/7)
```
martin.engineering: Add: quantization/precision recommendations and preferred batching window.
jordan.hw: Adding logistics note: include customs HS codes and shipper contact in the address sheet.
sara.partnerops: I'll assemble the marketplace checklist doc and ping legal for customs template. Action items: 1) @martin.engineering prepare lab env+load script by 5/5. 2) @jordan.hw collect shipping list by 5/6. 3) @alyssa.devex finalize cert rubric and exam link by 5/8. 4) I'll coordinate announcement embargo timing with marketing after we confirm dates.
deploy-bot: Created task PRJ-4567: "SI Skill Sprint — logistics & certs" assigned to sara.partnerops, due 2026-05-08.
martin.engineering: Quick Q — do we want a brief pre-read for SIs about runtime tradeoffs? I can draft a 1-pager.
sara.partnerops: Yes please — add the 1-pager to onboarding kit. Also thinking about running a dry-run with internal SIs week of 5/11. Who can attend? :calendar:
alyssa.devex: I can join the dry-run and act as proctor for the exam simulation.
jordan.hw: I'll be on call for hardware setup during dry-run.
sara.partnerops: Perfect. I'll create a shared calendar invite and a single GH repo for materials. Link will follow. Thanks team — will update this thread with links and the address spreadsheet. :thumbsup:
